text:
The Metropolitan police have announced a criminal investigation into David Walliams over alleged sexual misconduct.
In reports by the Guardian and ITV News, Walliams, 55, has been accused by multiple women of using his power and celebrity status to prey on young women and teenagers for sex.
Details of the allegations were revealed after a court rejected a legal attempt by Walliams aimed at preventing publication. He has denied any wrongdoing.
Walliams is one of Britain’s best-known television personalities and top-selling children’s authors.
In a statement announcing the criminal investigation, the Met said the serious allegations it was investigating were separate from those reported by news organisations. “In recent days, the Met has received a number of allegations of non-recent serious sexual offences involving a man now in his 50s.
“Those who have come forward are being supported by specialist officers.
“The allegations are separate from those reported by ITN and the Guardian. However, as part of their investigation, detectives are also proactively reviewing that reporting to establish whether there is any evidence of offences.”
Det Supt Mike Cagney, whose team is leading the investigation, said: “We would encourage anyone who has been the victim of a sexual offence to come forward and speak to us, no matter when it happened.
“We know reporting allegations of this nature can be daunting, but specialist officers are on hand to provide support, answer questions and guide you through the process.”
People could report information to police by calling 101 and providing the reference 4900/10NOV26, or by contacting the complex sexual offences unit on 0207 175 2738.
More details soon …

משטרת המטרופולין בלונדון הודיעה על פתיחת חקירה פלילית נגד איש הטלוויזיה וסופר הילדים דיוויד ווליאמס, בן 55, בגין חשדות לעבירות מין חמורות. ההודעה מגיעה לאחר שפרסומים בכלי תקשורת שונים הצביעו על כך שנשים רבות האשימו אותו בניצול מעמדו כדי לפגוע בנשים צעירות ובמתבגרות.

מהמשטרה נמסר כי התלונות החדשות שהתקבלו לאחרונה נפרדות מהפרסומים הקודמים בתקשורת, אך החוקרים בוחנים גם את אותם דיווחים כדי לאתר ראיות פליליות אפשריות. ווליאמס, מצדו, הכחיש את כל ההאשמות נגדו. הרשויות קוראות לקורבנות נוספים ליצור קשר עם יחידת עבירות המין המיוחדת כדי לקבל תמיכה וסיוע.
